dimensionEvidence.upperWing: NDL canvas 73, upper wing general drawing, 6000 mm half span and 2000 mm maximum outline chord; table chord is 1720 mm. The 2250 mm general-spec value is wheel track, not wing chord.
dimensionEvidence.lowerWing: NDL canvas 74, lower wing general drawing: 3790 mm outer panel plus center attachment gives 8520 mm span; maximum outline chord 1250 mm, table chord 1240 mm
dimensionEvidence.gapAndStagger: NDL canvas6, printed p.2: 翼間隔 approx1.595m, 喰違 approx0.4725m, 後退角0deg, 上反角4deg, 翼取付角 upper2deg/lower4deg, vertical fin left3deg40min. Canvas5 1580 mm is aerodynamic mean chord, 1240 mm is lower-wing chord, 2250 mm is wheel track. These separate columns were rechecked as full labeled crops before final geometry review.

conflicts: Notion incorrectly calls Ki-4 a low-wing monoplane. All three photographs and the original manual show a staggered sesquiplane.

Modern summaries mostly quote length 7.73 m / height 3.50 m; the opened 1937 primary manual says approximately 8.250 m / 3.310 m. The model follows the primary manual and records the disagreement instead of blending dimensions.

Photo02 shows the small rear-fuselage marking 141（中島製）. Photo01 has different large fuselage numerals and fin type text; these are not transferred to the selected Photo02 configuration. A photographed marking is not evidence of a Tengxian unit or combat history.
inferred: Paint hues and material reflectance cannot be measured from monochrome/sepia photographs; use restrained silver-doped fabric, aluminum skin and dark engine cowl as a declared reconstruction.
Cockpit colors, hidden fastener positions, backside details and internal engine plumbing not resolved by the manual photographs are reconstruction.

Internal tail-cone recess, balance-horn clearance pocket, exact hinge hardware and operational demonstration limits are functional reconstruction; they are checked against real rigid motion rather than claimed as photo-proven factory details.

Photo02 marking 141（中島製） is readable; the small prefix is transcribed as 機番 with lower confidence. Noto Sans supplies a reconstruction of the ink letterforms, not a claim of the exact original stencil font. Only the photographed side carries this mark.

Manual73/74 rib labels 1–38 and 1–23 and the denser outer spacing are retained. Outer upper intervals are readable; remaining inner station positions are calibrated from the scanned drawing and are not claimed as a complete factory dimensional survey.
Photos are same-type appearance references, not Tengxian field photographs. This asset does not establish Ki-4 participation in the Tengxian city assault.
SurfaceV2 texture characterization uses explicitly inferred imagegen references and CC0 material analogues; it does not establish exact historical colors, wear or upholstery.
axes: Source Blender X right, +Y nose, +Z up. Export glTF X right, Y up, -Z nose. Meters. Origin on centerline at ground datum.
